invariants.rationale: The method expects commitTimeline to be a valid HoodieTimeline for correct operation.
As a configuration parameter, hoodieWriteConfig is expected to be non-null for all method logic relying on it.
A positive file size limit is typical for meaningful partitioning and small file handling.
A positive estimation threshold is a reasonable assumption for trigger logic in record sizing.
The average record size estimate should be positive in deployment scenarios for size estimation to be valid.
